title: Morning in the hutong
blurb: A walk with Grandma, and a greeting that isn't a question.

paragraphs.zh: 今天早上，姥姥和我去遛弯儿。胡同里人很多。
paragraphs.en: This morning Grandma and I went for a stroll. There were lots of people in the hutong.

paragraphs.zh: 一个叔叔看见我们，说：“您吃了吗？”姥姥说：“吃了，您呢？”
paragraphs.en: A man saw us and said: "Have you eaten?" Grandma said: "Yes, and you?"
I thought: but we haven't eaten!

paragraphs.zh: 姥姥说：“没事儿。在这儿，‘吃了吗’就是‘你好’。”
paragraphs.en: Grandma said: "Don't worry. Here, 'have you eaten?' just means 'hello'."

paragraphs.zh: 然后咱们去吃饺子。这儿的饺子真地道，我吃了很多！
paragraphs.en: Then we went for dumplings. The dumplings here are really authentic, and I ate loads!
